svg.title: For completeness, every coarse face whose toll exceeds a fixed δ > 0 has an actual spending witness within distance R, once the scale parameter is late enough. Write T for the large spending threshold. If no spending base lies in that neighborhood, then every fine input in its macro port has toll at most T: listed inputs exceeding T would themselves be spending witnesses, while unlisted inputs have toll at most t/2 ≤T. Likewise every one of its four boundary wires is at most T, using the unlisted bound 2Wt ≤T. Its toll is then at most   4 + DL−2q| box((j + 7)L)| T.
